summary_en: 312 shares of Hipstar Gate to be purchased; remaining 88 shares acquired via simplified stock exchange. Bizmates to issue 100,732 new shares as consideration. Founders Watanabe Yoshifumi and Odagiri Shoji to receive shares with 3-year lock-up and minimum 3-year director retention. Completion targeted 2026-06-30.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of shares in Hipstar Gate Inc. and full subsidiary conversion through simplified stock exchange
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-25, Bizmates' board approved the acquisition of Hipstar Gate Inc. to make it a wholly-owned subsidiary via a two-step transaction: (1) direct share purchase of 312 shares from founders Watanabe Yoshifumi and Odagiri Shoji, and (2) simplified stock exchange (under Companies Act Article 796(2), no shareholder meeting required) of the remaining 88 shares. Bizmates will issue 100,732 new shares as consideration. Share acquisition is scheduled to close 2026-06-30. The founders will receive newly issued Bizmates shares locked up for 3 years and are required to remain as company officers for a minimum of 3 years, aligning their incentives with existing shareholders' long-term value creation. The strategic rationale centers on cross-selling Hipstar Gate's high-value training and diversity/equity/inclusion (DE&I) services to Bizmates' ~1,600 corporate clients; combining Bizmates' global talent development and language training with Hipstar Gate's 16-year track record in corporate training and DE&I advisory (backed by University of Tokyo graduate program expertise) to offer end-to-end capability covering language skills, management mind-set development, and leadership competencies.
